instruction: Open the web browser from the desktop
notes: the run assumes no browser is running, but these are: msedge.exe, chrome.exe. Text on screen cannot show this - a window behind another one carries no text - so the plan would be written against a window that already exists and the run could not be credited with opening it. Close them first.
